title: Kooky Dense British Beef Yorkshire Pudding
description: A funky twist on the traditional British dish, this recipe features tomato ketchup and coconut cream in a dense Yorkshire pudding, cooked in a kazan cauldron. It's an adventurous take on a classic Welsh meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, beef drippings, tomato ketchup, and coconut cream.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Add the beef broth and stir until the batter is smooth.
Heat a kazan cauldron over high heat on the stovetop.
Add a small amount of oil to the cauldron and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Pour the batter into the cauldron and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, then reduce the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
